lead.zh: 2025 年股东大会的发布方介绍聚焦接班、贸易、现金和市场波动。本篇是依据该介绍制作的阅读提纲，尚不是整场问答的转录整理。
lead.en: The publisher’s introduction highlights succession, trade, cash and volatility. This is a reading guide to that introduction, not an edition of the complete Q&A.

paragraphs.zh: 会议结束时，巴菲特宣布希望在年底交出首席执行官职位，并建议由 Greg Abel 接任。
paragraphs.en: At the close, Buffett announced his intention to step down as CEO at year-end and recommend Greg Abel.

paragraphs.zh: 发布方概述提到伯克希尔的大额现金。这应放在资本配置、经营需要与可选机会的背景中阅读。
paragraphs.en: The introduction notes Berkshire’s large cash position, a topic to examine alongside capital allocation, operating needs and available opportunities.

paragraphs.zh: 会议也讨论贸易与市场大幅波动。查看完整问答时，应区分经营判断与对当时市场环境的评论。
paragraphs.en: Trade and sharp market swings also feature. In the full discussion, distinguish business assessments from comments about contemporaneous markets.
